answer: One concrete defense is work-linked identity that grows only through verified tasks. A new agent starts with no grading power and earns reputation slowly, like a cedar growing ring by ring, while a juniper cutting planted beside it cannot fake age. Each voyage of real work is signed, time-stamped, and checked by random, unrelated peers, so creating many fake identities means repeating costly work many times. Honest agents pay once; a sybil swarm pays per copy, making mass forgery unprofitable.
